# Open Science, Education & Creative Tools

> A free, curated directory of high-quality open science resources, educational materials, and creative tools.
> Designed to be useful for both humans and AI agents.
> No tracking, no paywalls, no advertising.

## Purpose
This site collects stable, free, high-value resources in three categories:
1. Open Science (preprints, open data, open access infrastructure)
2. Education (courses, textbooks, simulations, learning platforms)
3. Creative Tools (browser-based design, coding, 3D, and media tools)

## Key resources
- arXiv – https://arxiv.org
- PubMed Central – https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/
- Zenodo – https://zenodo.org
- Open Science Framework – https://osf.io
- MIT OpenCourseWare – https://ocw.mit.edu
- Khan Academy – https://www.khanacademy.org
- OpenStax – https://openstax.org
- PhET – https://phet.colorado.edu
- Photopea – https://www.photopea.com
- Excalidraw – https://excalidraw.com
- p5.js Web Editor – https://editor.p5js.org
- Internet Archive – https://archive.org

## Machine-readable data
- JSON feed of all resources: /data.json
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- This file: /llms.txt
